question: The numerical value of (4)/(sec²theta) + (3)/(1+cot²theta) + sin²theta is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 90°** in the given expression.

⇒ 4/sec²90° + 3/(1+cot²90°) + sin²90°

⇒ 4/∞ + 3/(1+0) + (1)²

⇒ 0 + 3 + 1 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f03efce5eb6494da693a53c563eaf389a12f09f31456e83534162f7bdde1e6a.png] 

**Given:** Expression = 4/sec²θ + 3/(1+cot²θ) + sin²θ

**Formula Used:** 1/secθ = **cosθ**, 1 + cot²θ = **cosec²θ**, 1/cosecθ = **sinθ**, sin²θ + cos²θ = **1**

⇒ 4 × (1/sec²θ) + 3/(cosec²θ) + sin²θ

⇒ 4cos²θ + 3sin²θ + sin²θ

⇒ 4cos²θ + 4sin²θ

⇒ 4(cos²θ + sin²θ)

⇒ 4 × 1 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental relations: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Key ratios: cosθ = 1/secθ, sinθ = 1/cosecθ, and tanθ = 1/cotθ.</p
